data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 30,830,000 (2021: surplus of GBP 16,021,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. Prior year reserve releases on the 2019 and prior years of account contributed GBP 27.6 million to underwriting profit (2021: GBP 17.3 million), predominantly across the Property & Motor division.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 19.7 million, primarily driven by favourable claims development across the 2019 and prior years of account, predominantly in the Property and Motor divisions. However, the current year's claims ratio was higher due to catastrophe losses including Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot, and Sydney Floods, as well as provisions for the Ukraine War. Inflation was also a key consideration for the Board.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development of -19.7m GBP was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Note 10), as no explicit gross prior year movement figure was found. Narrative text on page 2 and 16 refers to 'net releases' of GBP 27.6m and 'net surplus' of GBP 30.83m respectively, which differ from the net prior year development of -33.4m calculated from the net claims development triangle. The LOB movements for Property & Motor are based on a net figure from narrative text, as no gross LOB breakdown was available.
